overview.positioning: Applied WordPress Visual Design & Conversion Landing Pages
overview.short_description: Learn to design professional WordPress websites using Elementor's visual design tools. Build modern responsive layouts with Flexbox containers, establish reusable styling systems, create consistent site templates and develop conversion-focused landing pages.
overview.why_it_matters: Turning design briefs into responsive, high-converting WordPress websites requires mastering modern container architecture and conversion UX rather than unmaintainable drag-and-drop bloat.
overview.sales_differentiation: Beyond Drag-and-Drop. Learn Structured Website Design. Students learn how to turn business requirements and design references into consistent, responsive and maintainable WordPress pages.

commercial_differentiation.headline: Beyond Drag-and-Drop. Learn Structured Website Design.
commercial_differentiation.supporting_copy: Students learn how to turn business requirements and design references into consistent, responsive and maintainable WordPress pages without unnecessary plugin bloat.
differentiators: Visual design fundamentals: typography scales, color harmony, and visual hierarchy
Modern responsive containers: Flexbox containers prioritized over legacy sections and columns
Design consistency: global fonts, global color tokens, and reusable visual patterns
Reusable layout systems: saved templates, custom headers, and multi-page layouts
Landing-page UX: conversion-focused section sequencing and friction reduction
Functional lead capture: validated forms, privacy notices, and anti-spam protection
Publishing quality: image compression, Core Web Vitals, and PageSpeed Insights audits
Client-ready delivery: structured documentation and client maintenance handoff

why_now.industry_shift: WordPress powers over 40% of the web, and Elementor's modern Flexbox container workflow has replaced legacy column-based page building, demanding structured design skills.
why_now.ai_impact: AI tools speed up copy generation and wireframing, but disciplined responsive layout engineering, visual harmony, and lead conversion UX remain essential human developer skills.
why_now.business_demand: Small businesses, agencies, and marketing teams require fast-loading, mobile-friendly landing pages and multi-page websites that convert visitors into qualified leads.
why_now.career_opportunity: Freelance designers and web agencies command premium rates for clean, maintainable Elementor builds that load swiftly and pass accessibility standards.

prerequisites.required: Basic WordPress knowledge (dashboard navigation, pages, menus) or completion of Course 62 (WordPress Website Design & Management).
prerequisites.not_required: Advanced coding (PHP, JavaScript) or prior professional design background.
prerequisites.hardware_software: Computer with modern web browser, local WordPress environment (LocalWP) or live WordPress hosting staging environment, Elementor Free installed.

highlights: 5 Weeks of intensive hands-on visual web design training (40 guided hours)
Modern Flexbox container architecture prioritized over legacy columns
Complete 5-page responsive business website capstone portfolio
Dedicated conversion-focused lead generation landing page with working form
Global design system implementation: fonts, colors, spacing, and buttons
Transparent licensing education: Elementor Free vs Elementor Pro capabilities
PageSpeed Insights performance optimization and image compression workflows

Comprehensive client handover handbook and maintenance documentation

licensing_transparency.summary: Clear distinction between Elementor Free and Elementor Pro paid features.
licensing_transparency.elementor_free: Core visual editing, supported Flexbox containers, layout tools, basic widgets, and standard styling features.
licensing_transparency.elementor_pro: Theme Builder (custom headers, footers, archive templates), native advanced forms, popups, and dynamic tags require an appropriate valid paid license.
licensing_transparency.course_policy: The course fee does NOT include an Elementor Pro license. Practical deliverables are completed using Elementor Free and reputable compatible free form plugins, with Pro features demonstrated in licensed instructor environments.

learning_outcomes: Understand the Elementor visual editing workflow.

Understand the purpose and licensing requirements of Theme Builder.
Configure or integrate a working lead form.
Design clear CTAs, social proof and pricing sections.
Test form success, validation and failure behavior.
Optimize images and identify avoidable page bloat.
Perform desktop, tablet and mobile QA.
Prepare client documentation and a website handover.

modules.module_purpose: Understand Elementor's workflow and apply sound visual design principles.

Pages vs posts vs theme templates
Theme compatibility (Hello Elementor, Astra)
Elementor plugin installation and activation

Widget library search and categories
Structure Navigator for DOM inspection
Page settings, canvas vs full-width templates

lessons.expected_outcome: Comfortable navigating Elementor panels, Structure Navigator, and revision controls.

Typography scales, font pairings, and line heights

lessons.why_it_matters: Clean visual design separates professional web designers from amateur template tweakers.
lessons.expected_outcome: Understanding of typography scales, color contrast, and white space in web layouts.

lessons.what_is_taught: Setting up Elementor Site Settings: global fonts, global colors, layout container widths, spacing scales, button styling defaults, and reusable visual patterns.

lessons.expected_outcome: Configured Elementor design system with global fonts, colors, and button standards.

modules.hands_on_practice: Create a branded design foundation and responsive hero section.

modules.expected_outcome: Elementor design foundation with consistent typography, colours and spacing.

modules.module_purpose: Master modern responsive layout design with Elementor containers.

lessons.what_is_taught: Flexbox container architecture, parent and child containers, nested container hierarchy, container direction (row vs column), and wrapping behavior.
subtopics: Modern Flexbox containers vs legacy sections/columns
Parent container layout settings and boundaries
Child container nesting and structured hierarchy
Container direction: Row horizontal vs Column vertical
Container wrapping and multi-item grid behavior
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds multi-container nested structures using modern Elementor Flexbox containers.
lessons.why_it_matters: Containers generate cleaner HTML DOM, load faster, and provide superior responsive control.
lessons.expected_outcome: Mastery of Flexbox container nesting and structural hierarchy.

lessons.what_is_taught: Flexbox alignment concepts: justify content, align items, align self, gap properties (row/column), container width, min-height, and flex grow/shrink sizing.
subtopics: Justify-content: start, center, end, space-between, space-around
Align-items: stretch, center, flex-start, flex-end, baseline
Managing gap properties for consistent component spacing
Container width units: percentage, pixels, viewport width (vw)
Min-height considerations (vh vs px) for full-screen hero sections
Flex grow, flex shrink, and flex basis controls
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures container alignment, justification, and gap properties to align visual widgets precisely.
lessons.why_it_matters: Flexbox controls eliminate arbitrary margins and create bulletproof responsive structures.
lessons.expected_outcome: Fluent manipulation of Flexbox justification, alignment, and gap properties.

lessons.what_is_taught: Responsive breakpoints (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile), breakpoint inheritance cascade, mobile-first vs desktop-first adjustments, responsive typography, and layout stacking.
subtopics: Elementor responsive mode controls and viewport toggles
Breakpoint inheritance: changes cascading from Desktop down
Responsive font sizes (rem, px, clamp) and line heights
Stacking horizontal rows into vertical mobile layouts
Padding and margin adaptations across device viewports
lessons.what_learner_does: Toggles responsive modes, adjusts typography and container widths, and verifies clean stacking.
lessons.why_it_matters: Over 60% of web traffic is mobile; designs must look intentional on every viewport.
lessons.expected_outcome: Fully responsive layouts that adapt smoothly across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

lessons.what_is_taught: Reverse container direction, custom order values, responsive width overrides, reordering content on mobile, and avoiding duplicate hidden sections.
subtopics: Reverse container direction on mobile (Row-Reverse / Column-Reverse)
Applying custom order values to individual child items
Responsive width overrides (e.g. 50% desktop to 100% mobile)
Preserving content hierarchy without cloning hidden sections
Avoiding duplicate DOM elements for SEO and performance
lessons.what_learner_does: Reorders mobile content (e.g., image above text) using CSS direction and order without duplicating sections.
lessons.why_it_matters: Duplicating sections for mobile bloats page size; Flexbox ordering solves it cleanly in CSS.
lessons.expected_outcome: Clean mobile reordering using container direction and order properties.

lessons.what_is_taught: Saved templates, reusable container sections, global styling synchronization, component consistency, and long-term site maintainability.
subtopics: Saving containers and sections as Elementor templates
Inserting saved templates across multiple pages
Managing template libraries and categorization
Maintaining component styling consistency across pages
Design system governance for multi-page websites
lessons.what_learner_does: Saves recurring UI patterns as templates and reuses them across different page contexts.
lessons.why_it_matters: Component reuse speeds up development by 40% and guarantees visual uniformity.
lessons.expected_outcome: Library of saved reusable Elementor templates ready for multi-page deployment.

lessons.what_is_taught: Constructing standard high-value layout patterns: two-column hero with media, multi-card services grid, feature comparison matrix, testimonial carousel/grid, contact section, and CTA banners.
subtopics: Two-column split hero with headline, copy, CTA, and visual
Three- and four-column services/features container grids
Feature comparison table / card layout
Testimonial cards with client avatar, quotes, and star ratings
Contact section with address info, map, and form container
High-contrast full-width CTA callout banner
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds complete, reusable container patterns for the core sections of a commercial website.
lessons.why_it_matters: These 6 patterns form the building blocks of 90% of commercial WordPress business websites.
lessons.expected_outcome: Suite of production-ready responsive layout patterns.

modules.hands_on_practice: Create a responsive business webpage containing reusable layout sections.

Internal linking strategy to guide visitor exploration
Maintaining brand tone and visual consistency across pages

lessons.why_it_matters: Thorough planning prevents rework and ensures an intuitive user experience.
lessons.expected_outcome: Complete 5-page site plan and content architecture blueprint.

lessons.what_is_taught: Saved page templates, section template reuse, page-level layouts, template export/import workflows, and safe template maintenance across environments.
subtopics: Creating and organizing Elementor saved templates
Exporting and importing JSON template files
Reusing page structures while altering text/media content
Template version control and naming conventions
Safe template updating without breaking live pages
lessons.what_learner_does: Exports, imports, and manages reusable page and section templates across pages.
lessons.why_it_matters: Template portability enables rapid deployment and modular website building.
lessons.expected_outcome: Organized library of portable Elementor JSON page and section templates.

lessons.what_is_taught: Header structure, responsive navigation menus, sticky headers, mobile hamburger menu UX, footer layout, copyright info, and theme compatibility.
subtopics: Designing desktop navigation with logo, menu, and header CTA
Configuring responsive mobile hamburger navigation
Sticky header behavior on scroll
Multi-column footer layout (about, links, contact, legal)
Ensuring theme header/footer compatibility or override
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds a consistent global header with responsive menu and a comprehensive multi-column footer.
lessons.why_it_matters: Headers and footers define the perimeter of every page and establish immediate brand trust.
lessons.expected_outcome: Fully responsive global header and footer operating across all pages.

lessons.what_is_taught: Theme Builder purpose, header/footer templates, single post templates, archive templates, display conditions, and feature licensing requirements.

Dynamic header and footer templates with display conditions
Single post and single page template generation
Archive and blog category page templates

Licensing transparency: Pro requirements vs free theme alternatives
lessons.what_learner_does: Studies Theme Builder display conditions and implements equivalent header/footer layouts.
lessons.why_it_matters: Understanding Theme Builder allows designers to evaluate when Pro licensing is necessary for a client.
lessons.expected_outcome: Solid comprehension of Theme Builder architecture, display conditions, and licensing boundaries.

lessons.what_is_taught: WordPress content relationships, dynamic post title and feature image tags, dynamic fields where supported, appropriate content reuse, and Pro feature limitations.

Dynamic tags concept: pulling post titles, dates, and featured images
Using dynamic content to populate template widgets
Appropriate content reuse across multiple pages
Clear boundary: what works in Free vs what requires Elementor Pro
lessons.what_learner_does: Connects dynamic data fields where supported and identifies static vs dynamic content areas.
lessons.why_it_matters: Dynamic tags eliminate manual updates for recurring content types.
lessons.expected_outcome: Understanding dynamic content integration and licensing constraints.

lessons.what_is_taught: Assembling the complete 5-page business site: Home (hero, value prop, proof), About (story, team, mission), Services (offerings, pricing), Portfolio (case studies), and Contact (details, map, form).
subtopics: Assembling the Homepage with clear conversion pathways
Designing the About page: brand story, mission, and team
Designing the Services page: detailed offerings and scope
Designing the Portfolio page: project showcase and case studies
Designing the Contact page: business details, map, and form

lessons.what_is_taught: Ad-to-landing-page scent, user friction analysis, form abandonment prevention, trust-building visual cues, and mobile conversion pathways.

Form abandonment triggers and mitigation strategies

faq.question: Do I need coding to learn Elementor?
faq.answer: No advanced coding is required. Basic WordPress knowledge is recommended to understand dashboard navigation, pages, and menus.

faq.question: What will I build?
faq.answer: A five-page WordPress business website and a conversion-focused landing page with a working lead form.

faq.question: Is Elementor Pro included?
faq.answer: Elementor Pro features depend on an appropriate paid license. The course explains licensing and supports practical workflows using available authorized tools. Do not claim a paid license is included unless confirmed.

faq.question: Will I learn responsive website design?
faq.answer: Yes. The course focuses on modern Flexbox containers, mobile layouts, responsive ordering and consistent styling.

faq.question: Will I learn lead-generation landing pages?
faq.answer: Yes. The curriculum includes landing-page structure, CTAs, forms, trust signals and lead-journey testing.

faq.question: Is this different from the WordPress course?
faq.answer: Yes. Course 62 teaches WordPress foundations and administration, while Course 65 specializes in visual page design and conversion-focused experiences.

faq.question: Will I learn website performance optimization?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn practical image, layout and page-speed checks.

faq.question: What is the duration and fee?
faq.answer: Five weeks, 40 guided hours and ₹5,900, subject to Nova Skills' verified pricing and tax policy.
